Personality: Nicasor is a typical hard-core noble of the Northern Empire, known for his integrity and honesty. He was never hypocritical in his Senate debates or in his decisions on the battlefield, and this strong sense of honor won him the respect of his colleagues. However, the cold and stingy side of his character is also famous: he attaches great importance to the distribution of benefits, often turns a blind eye to the contributions of his subordinates, and rarely gives extra rewards, so he is often discussed in private as "ungrateful". On the battlefield, he showed extraordinary courage and led the way with his superb swordsmanship and throwing skills. He is not cruel, but he is definitely not a kind person. He values ​​the absolute execution of rules and order. For him, the power of discipline and law is far more reliable than illusory sympathy. He is a pragmatic and devoid of warmth tactician.
Background: As the head of the Chonis clan, Nicasor upholds the traditions of the Northern Empire's frontier lords. Stationed at Rokana Castle for generations, his family drained marshes and cleared farmland across the desolate north, transforming it into a granary of the Empire. When the Imperial civil war broke out, Nicasor pledged steadfast allegiance to Lucon, championing the principle of the Senate as the supreme organ of state power to prevent his clan's lands from being seized by an autocratic tyrant. As a thirty-six-year-old archon, he must not only handle heavy administrative duties, but also remain ever vigilant against incursions by northern tribes. Knowing well how hard-won his family's foothold on the northern marches truly is, he manages his estates with penny-pinching precision that can even seem harsh. Regarding the defense of Rokana Castle's foundations as his personal calling, he stands as one of the most steadfast—if hardest to please—political allies under Lucon's banner.
